name: model/download
description: Download a base model from HuggingFace to a local or remote grid node. Routes to GPU-capable node if needed. Wraps huggingface_hub snapshot_download with progress reporting via chat.

params.name: node
params.description: Target grid node IP or name. Default: local machine, or GPU node if model requires GPU.

params.name: revision
params.description: Specific revision/branch/tag to download. Default: main.

results.name: downloadPath
results.description: Local path where the model was downloaded

results.name: nodeId
results.description: Which grid node the model was downloaded to
